name: details-edge
body:
The durable spec's `details` edge kind: a note-source annotation edge that attaches a durable note to the thing it explains. Its source must be a `Note` (any of the four authored layers plus `global`). Its target may be an authored node — stakeholder/user/requirement/group/entity/value/service/system/container/component/person/constraint, in any layer — or a code FQN (module/file/struct/function).

`Note`→`Note` `details` is deliberately excluded, because a note may not detail another note. `Note` stays REVIEWABLE: that is the distinct `Reviews` edge (`Feedback`→`Note`), untouched by this rule.

The one canonical rule this edge kind enforces is the `Note` exclusion on both sides: the write surface (`rust.apg.layers.validate.validate_edge`) refuses a `Note`-target `details` pair at write time, and the projection (`rust.apg.load.tables.spec_rel_pairs`'s `Details` target list, which omits `Note`) omits it — so the excluded pair is refused at write time rather than accepted-and-dropped. The write surface validates no other `details` target: non-`Note` targets (including code FQNs and dangling targets) are written unvalidated, so the write surface and the projection are NOT asserted to share a common target set and no no-loss guarantee is made. The projection's exclusion of `Note` is canonical; the write surface is the side that moves.
